foundations_pr_scope.title: Add canonical native control and collection foundations
foundations_pr_scope.delivered: Reduced redundant resident comparison/collection work; checked canonical scalar arithmetic/casts, Match and scalar literal loops; admitted typed managed-value storage and one cumulative native/library account; selected maintained root/lexical collection binding; generated mixed JIT control through the shared emitter/current-visit checker. The ownership correction bounds deregistration and exact same-owner reuse independently of later foreign imports.
foundations_pr_scope.boundary: PR905 foundations are not completed production canonical AOT or a benchmark-qualified workload. The subsequent PR906 continuation qualifies actual linked mixed programs and native matrix comprehensions as recorded below; those results do not establish full resource integration or the benchmark. The independent raw-source native fallback chain remains unresolved, not an accepted second canonical runtime authority.
foundations_pr_scope.change_policy: After the concrete ownership correction and accurate scope/evidence, stop adding compiler features to PR905. Handle corrective review/CI findings through existing gates. Do not mark ready or merge without explicit user approval; no new PR is authorized by this roadmap.

milestones.name: Complete canonical production and native resource integration
completion_criteria: Route production native builds through the same validated canonical ProgramArtifact and selected operation bindings. Remove the raw-source sequence/control/grid fallback chain from the route presented as canonical AOT. Unsupported constructs fail explicitly at that boundary; no whole-program interpreter fallback, competing semantic authority or workload-sized Rust bridge.

Complete general native collections/matrices, comprehensions, element-wise application counts, computed activation/state and FSM control through canonical language semantics and shared validation/publication machinery. Preserve checked arithmetic/casts, source error order, exact geometry, cumulative work and memory admission, and failure recovery.

Connect typed argv/stdin/stdout/raw-byte capabilities, strict immutable payload argument separation/count, observations, ordered effects, output staging/flush, shutdown and errors. Keep compilation separate from live drivers, transactions and replay; hosted resident success does not establish native AOT resource support.

Audit and close borrowed structural projection metadata charges in initial/refined plans including budget None, without double charging. Provide genuine recursive tree/reference allocation and arena/frame lifetimes, non-tail recursive work, bigint primitives and byte operations where the ten programs require them; retain original failing fixtures and unchanged admission limits.

Parse, compile and execute all ten canonical idiomatic programs with full input/output and required-work contracts, including ordinary functions/captures, named outputs, pipelines, repeated application, Match and state machines. Validate publication LOC from the executed sources, not archived unrun candidates.

milestones.name: Qualify the full workload, then measure and optimize
completion_criteria: Reduce actual general collection/histogram work and provide canonical packed/streaming execution for all seven k-nucleotide histograms, not just the two short keys or workload-specific helpers. Run standard FASTA N=25000000 and its full THREE=125000000-base record with exact independent output and complete resource lifecycle.

Retain ordinary 100/400-base success and 4000-base denial/recovery under unchanged defaults. Qualify finite explicit full-input policy separately; do not raise, reset, discount or bypass admission to make a fixture pass.

Qualify trusted and secured modes of the SAME AOT executable across startup, arguments, inputs, work, output/flush, shutdown and errors before timing. Preserve executable/source/configuration/input pins and complete raw streams.

Run release Mech-only measurements serially after correctness/admission gates pass. Publish raw samples, reproducible commands, lifecycle/mode definitions and security overhead. Preserve existing other-language cohorts and historical optimization evidence; never overlap measurements.

Analyze the actual generated executable, binary size, hot paths and dependencies; optimize the real canonical path, remeasure, and expose explicit checked-AOT configuration while retaining admission, exact results and failure behavior. Do not substitute scalar samples, hosted runtime timings or copied old measurements for full-program native results.
Resolve all current review findings and obtain fresh clean review plus complete exact-head green CI. Leave readiness and merging to explicit user approval.

changes: General iterative String-byte radix ordering with occupied-bucket bitsets, bounded admitted workspace and no recursive host stack. All byte distribution is compute-metered. One equality pass saves run starts for histogram construction instead of repeating key comparisons and count loops.

String set comparison reservation is derived from bounded heapsort, deduplication and sorted core finalization. Each comparison consumes its byte allowance before the shared core key relation runs; core finalization receives only the remainder of the same reservation. The broader metadata/payload-move compute bound remains.

Snapshot pattern binding excludes its prior target from the same unchanged local measurement using checked footprint subtraction, including all repeated matching regions. It no longer traverses all other locals twice before the first scratch write.
